world_rationale: Fresh static whole-world quality accept after inspecting all 252 concept definitions, 352 pair recipes, 32 named goals, 12 unlock supply groups and the current world configuration. The eight familiar starters support nine productive pairs with seven distinct first discoveries: dough, pasta, cheese, brine, polenta, omelette and boiled egg. Bread then uses dough and oven; bulz combines polenta and cheese. These routes teach ingredients, preparation and reuse before the pantry, lunch and confectionery branches broaden play. Recipe explanations explicitly describe omitted ingredients and processing, matching the stated two-key-idea abstraction rather than claiming complete cooking instructions. Specific late intermediates such as choux dough, ganache, toasted breadcrumbs and fistic-kataif filling make ecler, profiterol, pane and Dubai-chocolate routes legible instead of arbitrary generic pairs. Everyday bread, soups, preserves, dairy and meals carry the supply; optional international or fashionable dishes do not replace that familiar backbone. The 32 titles name their targets honestly, and no goal is a starter. All recipe endpoints exist; no input pair has competing outputs and no result equals its own input. A conservative static fixed-point calculation counting only distinct recipe outputs toward unlock thresholds reaches all 252 concepts, all 148 recipe outputs, all 12 unlocks and all 32 goals. This checks data reachability, not runtime play or enjoyment. Bounded discovery remains a fixed 352 unique pairs over 252 concepts, rather than unrestricted inferred combinations. World ID, eight starters, every recipe, goal, unlock and all ten unique compatible-version records are exactly retained from the installed n1 predecessor; only the four inspected alias snapshots change.
